turns.text: Hi, I would like to book a tattoo.

I can help you start a tattoo booking. A colleague handles these, so I'll pass your request on once I have a few details. Please tell me: 1) the idea or design you have in mind, 2) the size, 3) where on your body you want it, and 4) when you are available.
The idea is a small paper boat, about 8 cm wide, on the outside of my left forearm. I can come on weekday evenings.

Thank you. I've passed your request to a colleague with the details: a small paper boat, about 8 cm wide, on the outside of your left forearm, available on weekday evenings. A colleague will take over from here.
